start: Track standard, all four gates approved, slice 01 pending with a full packet: Tests first, the frozen signature archive_stale(notes, now), Allowed files notes.py and test_archive.py, and Verify.
measures: Red is real: at the red commit each new test fails on an assertion or the stub's NotImplementedError, never on an import, syntax or name error; old tests pass; the new tests are the packet's Tests first, pass against the reference implementation, each catches one of two mutants, and stay unchanged at green. At HEAD the hidden tests pass.

scores.red_real: share of tests new at test(red01): slice 01 red that fail or error with AssertionError or NotImplementedError
scores.old_tests_pass: share of tests passing at the red commit's parent that still pass at the red commit
scores.names_match: the new test names equal the Tests first names in 04-slices.md
scores.tests_unchanged: git diff <red> <feat> on the red commit's test files is empty
scores.reference_green: share of new tests passing at the red commit with oracle/green/notes.py laid over it
scores.mutants_killed: share of new tests failing with AssertionError on grading/mutant_empty.py or grading/mutant_ge.py
scores.hidden_pass: share of grading/test_hidden_archive.py passing at HEAD
